title: FoundryCarveoutRegistry
description: Spec-036 FR-062 / Plan-decision 16 / ADR-036-009 — registry of Azure AI Foundry features used outside the AU East boundary. CI fails when registry is empty while code references a `# carveout:<id>` marker (T-U03/T-U04).

$schema.description: Optional self-reference to the schema file.

version.description: Semver of the registry document shape.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by `# carveout:<id>` markers in source code.

region.description: Azure region where the carve-out is consumed (e.g. `eastus`, `westeurope`).

sku.description: Foundry deployment SKU or feature name (e.g. `GPT-4o`, `Foundry-eval`).

justification.description: Why the carve-out is required despite the AU residency invariant (FR-062).

expiry_date.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the carve-out is stale; CI fails on stale entries.

owner.description: Email of the team or individual responsible for retiring the carve-out.

sli_impact.description: SLI identifiers (per ADR-036-008) that the carve-out is expected to perturb.

approved_by.description: Optional approver name or governance ticket reference.

approval_reference.description: Optional link to the change/approval ticket.
